proposals.issue_title: Silent GHA Workflow Failures and Mobile Monitoring Blindspot
proposals.current_pain_description: Workflows run on GitHub Actions. When APIs hit rate limits (429), fail, or tokens expire, the failures are silent. Since Hugo works exclusively on an Android phone, checking raw GHA logs is tedious and slow, leading to wasted days before realizing a pipeline is broken.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a unified `utils/notifier.py` script that hooks into GHA's `always()` post-actions. It must send structured, actionable error alerts (including pipeline name, error snippet, and a direct link to the GHA run) to a free Telegram bot channel. This fits mobile-first monitoring perfectly.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces MTTR (Mean Time to Resolution) from days to minutes; saves Hugo from manually checking GHA on a small mobile screen.

proposals.issue_title: Monolithic and Duplicate Image Generation Logic
proposals.current_pain_description: Every pipeline independently implements its own HTTP requests, error handling, and API calls to image generators (Pollinations, Together AI, Runware). If an API endpoint changes, or when transitioning to Runware PAYG, Hugo must manually modify dozens of scripts.
proposals.proposed_fix: Refactor all image generation logic into a single, robust helper module: `utils/image_generator.py`. This module will manage API authentication, implement automatic retries (exponential backoff), handle fallback routing (Together AI -> Cloudflare -> Runware -> Pollinations), and enforce image aspect ratios.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Drastically reduces code duplication, simplifies adding new image APIs, and guarantees system resilience if one API fails.

proposals.issue_title: Unfiltered Grayscale and Broken Line Art in Coloring Books
proposals.current_pain_description: Raw AI generations from FLUX-schnell often include gray shading, gradients, fuzzy artifacts, or double lines. On KDP, this looks highly unprofessional and results in bad reviews or refunds.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add an automated Python post-processing step using Pillow and OpenCV. Apply adaptive thresholding (Otsu's binarization) to force pixels into pure black and white, run a morphological 'opening' pass to clear up speckles, and save as high-contrast, clean-line PDFs ready for print.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Ensures consistent, commercial-grade quality for KDP books without requiring manual editing on Hugo's Android phone.

proposals.current_pain_description: If Hugo switches to Runware PAYG (with a €20/month limit) to solve the image quality bottleneck, a bug in a looping GHA cron job could trigger thousands of API calls, exhausting his entire monthly budget in a single night.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a local JSON-based rate-limiter/budget-guard file (`.budget_state.json`) stored in the repository or a persistent GitHub Cache. Every image-generation run must query this file, check the timestamp, and block execution if the daily spending cap (e.g., €0.66/day) is exceeded.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Guarantees Hugo never exceeds his hard €20/month budget limit due to runaway loops or automated retries.

proposals.issue_title: Manual File Transfer Bottleneck from GHA to Android
proposals.current_pain_description: Once GHA builds a book PDF, a zip of tumbler wraps, or STL files, Hugo must log into GitHub on his phone, download the run artifact, extract it, and prepare it for upload. This manual path is highly friction-intensive on mobile.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate an automated upload step at the end of successful production runs. Use the free Google Drive API or Dropbox API to upload the final distribution-ready zip directly to a specific folder, then send a direct download link via the Telegram alert bot.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves 10-15 minutes of clunky mobile UI navigation per product generated, freeing up Hugo's limited 10 hours/week.

proposals.issue_title: Missed Cross-Pollination of Generated Vector/Line Art
proposals.current_pain_description: High-quality vector line art generated for 'Coloring Books' is only packaged as a PDF. The exact same assets are highly valuable on Etsy as SVG sticker packs, embroidery patterns, or laser cutting files, but they are currently discarded.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a `produce_cross_format_pack` post-processor. When a high-quality line-art image is generated, save the raw high-res PNG, auto-vectorize it to SVG using `potrace` (compiled in Termux or run via GHA Ubuntu environment), and package it as an Etsy-ready digital download pack.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies the revenue potential of a single generated asset across multiple platforms (Etsy SVG packs + KDP Coloring Books) with zero extra API cost.
